summary: Review stopped after its validation wrapper emitted unassigned-page coverage metadata. No acceptance or completed review is claimed.

incident.violated_constraint: Print only needed non-event fields for this task; internal full-record validation must not emit unassigned records.

review_state.remaining_checks: Both replay CLI validations, independent aggregate verifier, required repository checks and final preservation recheck were not completed.

candidate_finding_for_fresh_review.observation: Fresh original inspection shows the intended visible 4 hit-marker crop cuts through the right stem of the digit. This is a candidate finding requiring fresh scoped verification, not a completed review decision.

validation_state.source_suite_restricted: Failed with WinError 5 on pytest temporary directory; unchanged exact approved command launched, completion not consumed before stop.

required_resolution: Coordinator assesses this incident and launches a fresh bounded reviewer session. Keep validation stdout in private logs; emit only command/exit and explicitly selected task fields. Preserve this attempt and frozen inputs.
